_comment: Fictional crews (made-up names, colours and bosses; not real gangs). The player joins one at the start of a new game.

crews.name: Tortel Laaities
crews.perk_text: Home turf: +R150 and a head start on Westridge influence.
crews.pitch: Born and raised on Tortel Lane. They look after their own street and the corner shop.
crews.warning: This is Tortel Lane, %s. Keep walking.

crews.name: Spine Road Stylers
crews.perk_text: Low profile: police heat builds 40% slower.
crews.pitch: Quiet, clever and patient. They'd rather not be seen than be feared.

crews.name: Dune Cruisers
crews.perk_text: Quick hands: +25% cash from every mission. Lentegeur is cheaper to unlock.
crews.pitch: The flats and the field are theirs. Fast with money, faster on their feet.

crews.name: Rock Royals
crews.perk_text: Hard as stone: you start with a shotgun as well as the pistol. Rocklands is cheaper to unlock.
crews.pitch: Old quarry families. Slow to anger, impossible to move.
